reviews.review:
I originally got the game on console back when it came out for a PREORDER special.  Even then the game was just god awful.

NOW I am one of those hard core Warhammer 40K fans.  So I've no issue with spreading my fanboy moments here.

First off let's look at the positive 
The weapons are pretty kick ass.  The Chain Sword and Bolter are my all time favorite weapons.  So weilding both is awesome.  They look and sound fantastic.  
The designs of all the characters from the main characters, the Guard, Chaos Marines and even the armor types for multiplayer are pretty amazing.  

Unfortunately that's all I have for a positive review.

The Campaign for Single Player is poorly written, pitting only THREE space marines on a planet.  Who are supposed to be the ultra-bad asses.  But let's be honest, even a squad of 3 marines are no match for a horde of Orks.  Just ask any Table Top player.  Even in the stories and lore there are whole armies against such a massive invasion.  So telling ME a Captain and TWO Ultramarines are going to be the saviors of a planet is pretty hard to swallow.  I don't care if they are the Emperor's Finest, even a veteran Marine will tell you there's better odds with more than just 'THREE' marines.

Secondly is the melee.  There's no real control of swining your weapon.  You just go around, wildly swinging like a mad man, hoping to HIT anything.  Even then, it's not as satisfying.  This includes multiplayer.  Melee combat is limited to TWO modes Swining a weapon and Charge Bash with your shoulder.  
There's no guard mode or power swing.  You just swing and swing mashing that mouse button, hoping you hit someone.

Third is the camera.  the Third Person view does NOT work for a game like this.  It often gets stuck pushing against a wall or flooded with so much crap going on you can't tell what's up or down.  If you have Epilepsy, DO NOT GET THIS!  I'm not even joking.
The Camera is the biggest problem with the game for both campaign and multiplayer.  

The Fourth is...the game is just old.  Relic is now owned by SEGA after THQ filed for bankruptcy years back.  So now the game is in it's current state.  
So if you're a total noob to the game and come into Multiplayer, chances are you're gonna get raped.  The game includes unlocks for stat boosts to weapons and players.  That you'll be fighting op weapons with a pea-shooter and cardboard armor.

Unless you REALLY REALLY REALLY wanna play this game.  My advice is wait for it to go on sale and get it.  Even then get it for like $5.  Cause it is not worth the current price.

the Fifith is regarding  health restore in the Campaign.  
Now in Multiplayer your health will regenerate.  But in the Campaign, you have to perform executions on enemies to restore health.  Even then, you'll still take on damage while performing the animation.  So good luck healing up off a sweet animated kill.  

Sixth is teh environments.  It's like the artists just got lazy or something, many of the layouts are just so poorly done it's pathetic.  After titles like th Dawn of War franchise, you'd think they put more effort into it?  
In the Campaign the maps guide you down the path your ment to take.  There's no reall openess to anything and even then, theirs' not enough design or difference in the colors too make them stand out.  Everything looks and feel claustrophobic and subpar.
Multiplayer is probably the only exception.  Each map is designed as an arena style battlefield.  So team A & B have the same basic layout, just alternate colors too differenciate 

Pros
+ Sound
+ Design of characters
+ Design of weapons
+ Voice Actors
+ Varied Armor types and customization for multiplayer

Cons
- Camera control
- melee is lacking
- Campaign story 
- world maps are poorly designed
- not many play multiplayer anymore
- campaign health restore

2 servo skulls out of 5
A great game to play with friends with a good story an absolute must have when its on sale.
Said this game sounded like an orgy, someone called me a gentleman and a scholar. 10/10.

This game was practically Gears of War in the Warhammer universe.

was a great 5 1/2 hours of fun for super cheap.

This game made me go read more into the Warhammer lore. Which i enjoyed also.

Don't buy full price, but pick it up on sale for sure.

6/10
